To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the adoption, implementation, and continuation of a school-based health education program can be enhanced by teacher curriculum-related beliefs and contextual factors.
the implementation of a school based health promotion program is enhanced by teacher curriculum-related beliefs and by contextual factors.

1) teachers' curriculum-related beliefs are the main determinant for the implementation of LLL, 2) teacher training and interactive contextual factors (school policy, support from the governing body and students' response) influence the implementation and continuation of LLL, and 3) teachers' curriculum related beliefs are the most important factor in the diffusion of LLL, followed by teacher training and interactive contexts.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the implementation of health promotion interventions in schools.
the question: what are the factors that influence the adoption, implementation, and continuation of school based health promotion programs, and what can be done to optimize their diffusion?
the implementation and continuation of the LLL sex education program in Dutch secondary education.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the adoption of the LLL program was predominantly related to the teacher's curriculum-related beliefs, whereas implementation completeness, implementation fidelity and continued use were also enhanced by teacher training and interactive contextual factors (school policy, support by the governing body and student response).
the implementation of a sex-education program can be enhanced by a positive attitude towards the curriculum and by teacher training and interactive contextual factors.

the implementation of LLL was positively influenced by the following factors: teacher curriculum-related beliefs (adoption, implementation and continuation), teacher training (implementation), school policy (implementation and continuation) and student response (continuation).
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the diffusion of health promotion programs in schools is a complex process and that the implementation of health promotion programs is a key factor to ensure the success of the program.
the adoption, implementation, and continuation of school health promotion programs is influenced by teacher-related factors and contextual factors.
the diffusion of LLL was influenced by a complex interplay of teacher and contextual characteristics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
teachers are the most important agents of change.
the adoption and continuation of a program can be enhanced by providing teacher training and by creating an interactive context.
a program's implementation is not just the responsibility of teachers, but also of school administrators.
